messages:
kyle: Flagging a recurring pattern: when ETL lags hit ~10-20m we see a "zeroing" event in daily aggregates. This popped up again this morning. Seems related to trace ingestion failures + an aggregator step that treats missing groups as empty.
meera: saw it too. quick hypothesis: malformed payloads cause trace_id gen to fail -> those spans go to the null-path and an upstream filter ends up dropping them before aggregation.
sre-bot: incident_alert: agg_zero_spike detected at 2025-04-10T09:12:05Z details=(lag=13m, affected_windows=3) :warning:
ana: Proposed immediate checklist: 1) hotpatch ingest to route malformed spans to a spillover stream instead of dropping, 2) run a targeted reconciliation sweep for affected windows, 3) schedule permanent fixes + CI scenario, 4) record owners+due-dates in the postmortem action ledger.
ben: I'll own the reconciliation sweep. SQL to enumerate suspect windows: ```sql
SELECT metric_key, window_start, sum(raw_events) AS raw_count, sum(coalesce(agg_count,0)) AS agg_count,
       sum(raw_events) - sum(coalesce(agg_count,0)) AS delta
FROM reconciliation_view
WHERE ingestion_time >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY metric_key, window_start
HAVING abs(sum(raw_events) - sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) > 3
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
kyle: timeline suggestion: HOT (0-90m) = ingest spillover hotpatch (meera) + sampling (ben). SHORT (2-8h) = reconciliation sweep + small backfills (ben). MEDIUM (24-72h) = permanent ingest validation + unit/ci tests (ana). LONG (1-2w) = add a scheduled "reconciliation sweep" and rotate ownership weekly for 6 weeks.
meera: I'll open a hotfix branch that coalesces missing trace_id -> gen_uuid() and tags rows with "ingest_mitigated=spill_v1"; also add a metric ingest_spill_rate. PR ETA 35m. Note: this will temporarily increase cardinality; I'll notify analytics.
nana: Permanent fix plan: 1) add an explicit guard in the aggregator to avoid divide-by-zero and NaN propagation, 2) add CI synthetic that injects malformed spans and late arrivals, 3) add runbook section "malformed-span -> reconciliation". I'll draft CI tests and runbook entries.
ben: Backfill approach: prioritized recompute for top-N metric_key/windows from the sampler; idempotent upsert into aggregator_canonical annotated with reconciled_by='recon-3011112222'. Sample backfill SQL: ```sql
INSERT INTO aggregator_canonical (metric_key, window_start, value, reconciled_by)
SELECT metric_key, window_start, computed_value, 'recon-3011112222'
FROM recompute_from_raw
WHERE (metric_key, window_start) IN (<prioritized_list>)
ON CONFLICT (metric_key, window_start) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, reconciled_by = EXCLUDED.reconciled_by;
```
kyle: owners: meera=hotpatch+notify, ben=reconciliation+sweep+backfill, ana=permanent fix+CI+runbook, kyle=postmortem owner+product comms. I'll add due-dates: hotpatch 90m, sample 3h, backfill start 6h, postmortem updated 48h.
meera: quick mitigation note: I'll gate the hotpatch behind a feature-flag and can roll back if we see unexpected cardinality churn.
nana: also propose a new alert: "reconciliation_delta_rate" > 0.5% for 30m -> page oncall. We'll add a dashboard panel and a runbook step to check reconciliation trends.
ben: sampling results posted in #eng-data: 14 windows exceed threshold, top 5 keys show deltas 6-180 events. Starting prioritized backfill in ~2.5h after hotpatch confirmation.
sre-bot: deploy_event: hotpatch/ingest-spill_v1 opened at 2025-04-10T09:40:02Z by meera
kyle: good. closing criteria to mark postmortem done: (1) hotpatch merged & verified in prod, (2) prioritized backfill completed and validated by analytics, (3) reconciliation sweep scheduled weekly for 6 weeks with ownership rotation, (4) postmortem doc updated with action ledger and due dates.
meera: PR up for review, tagging @ana for aggregator guard coordination.
nana: will add CI synthetic test and the runbook change. ETA for CI tests + runbook: 48h.
ben: will post backfill results and validation metrics in this thread when done.
kyle: thanks everyone. check-in 6h or sooner if blocker. :thumbsup:
